items.title: PHM-ensemble: Scalable and Stable Probabilistic Multiresolution Clustering via Ensemble Density Estimation
items.title_zh: PHM-ensemble：通过集成密度估计实现可扩展且稳定的概率多分辨率聚类
items.summary_zh: 聚类是跨科学探索性数据分析的基础工具。我们认为聚类方法应从四个维度评估：对数据底层结构的保真度、恢复组的可解释性、在数据扰动和算法随机性下的稳定性，以及对现代科学数据集的可扩展性。然而现有方法很少满足所有四个标准。为填补这一空白，我们引入PHM-ensemble，一个通用的概率多分辨率聚类框架，通过汇集来自一组拟合的混合模型来估计底层数据密度，随后通过混合成分的层次合并构建聚类层次。在模拟数据集和MNIST基准上，PHM-ensemble在与真实值的一致性方面匹配或优于广泛使用的聚类算法，在多次运行中产生更稳定的结果，并揭示复杂的底层结构。应用于人类免疫健康图谱的182万外周血细胞，PHM-ensemble与专家策划的主要细胞类型注释的一致性高于原始研究中使用的Leiden聚类（调整兰德指数0.965对0.789），同时仅需一半计算时间。除了识别主要免疫谱系外，它还揭示细胞类型之间生物学一

extra.description: Clustering is a foundational tool for exploratory data analysis across the sciences. We argue that clustering methods should be evaluated along four dimensions: fidelity to the data's underlying structure, interpretability of the recovered groups, stability under data perturbations and algorithmic randomness, and scalability to modern scientific datasets. Yet existing methods rarely satisfy all four criteria. To address this gap, we introduce PHM-ensemble, a general probabilistic framework for multiresolution clustering that estimates the underlying data density by pooling mixture models from an ensemble of fits and subsequently constructs a clustering hierarchy through hierarchical merging of the mixture components. On simulated datasets and the MNIST benchmark, PHM-ensemble matches or outperforms widely used clustering algorithms in agreement with ground truth, produces more stable results across runs, and reveals complex underlying structures. Applied to 1.82 million peripheral blood cells from the Human Immune Health Atlas, PHM-ensemble achieves higher agreement with expert-curated major cell-type annotations than the Leiden clustering used in the original study (adjusted Rand index 0.965 versus 0.789), while requiring only half the computing time. Beyond identifying major immune lineages, it reveals biologically coherent relationships among cell types and resolves finer structure within individual lineages, uncovering subtypes and cellular states consistent with known biology.

items.title: LeCellModel: Interpretable Density Estimation over the Gene Expression Manifold
items.title_zh: LeCellModel：基因表达流形上的可解释密度估计
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA-seq的表示学习一直通过表示所捕获的身份——细胞类型、谱系、扰动——而非其建模基因表达流形上细胞状态分布的忠实程度来评估。因此，密度估计、稀有状态检测、扰动评分和基因水平归因作为独立模型附加到冻结嵌入上，与数据几何脱节。我们认为建模细胞状态分布应是主要目标，表示质量由此而来。基于LeJEPA（其SIGReg目标强制可证明最优的各向同性高斯潜在），我们引入LeCellModel，在该高斯潜在下将编码器的雅可比对数体积（JEPA-SCORE）解读为相对典型性评分。在多个数据集上，LeCellModel在scIB基准的表示质量上优于既定方法。此外，我们证明LeCellModel能够使用JEPA-SCORE作为典型性度量检测稀有表达状态，将其应用于受控细胞因子面板，在少数比例中识别刺激细胞并追踪通路响应幅度。我们引入典型性评分的基因水平可解释性——据我们所知，这是首个在特征空间分析J

extra.description: Representation learning for single-cell RNA-seq has been evaluated by the identities representations capture -- cell types, lineages, perturbations -- rather than how faithfully they model the distribution of cell states on the gene expression manifold. As a result, density estimation, rare-state detection, perturbation scoring, and gene-level attribution are bolted onto frozen embeddings as separate models, disconnected from the geometry of the data. We argue that modeling the distribution of cell states should be the primary objective, and that representation quality follows from it. Building on LeJEPA, whose SIGReg objective enforces a provably optimal isotropic Gaussian latent, we introduce LeCellModel, which reads the encoder's Jacobian log-volume (JEPA-SCORE) under this Gaussian latent as a relative typicality score. Across several datasets, LeCellModel outperforms established methods on the scIB benchmark for representation quality. Furthermore, we show that LeCellModel enables detection of rare expression states using JEPA-SCORE as a typicality measure, applying it to a controlled cytokine panel, where it identifies stimulated cells across minority fractions and tracks pathway-response magnitude. We introduce gene-level interpretability of the typicality score -- to our knowledge, the first method for analyzing JEPA-SCORE in feature space. Leveraging this framework, LeCellModel recapitulates the known association of a profibrotic macrophage program with idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis, and discovers a CD177+ activated regulatory T cell subpopulation previously described only in tumor contexts. Both findings emerge directly from the geometry of the learned embedding, without relying on supervised annotations.

items.title: Reproducible quantum clustering for single-cell transcriptome atlases
items.title_zh: 用于单细胞转录组图谱的可复现量子聚类
items.summary_zh: 当前的单细胞聚类流程丢弃了大多数基因，并且在不同随机种子下可能产生不一致的聚类。我们介绍了KQE-2，一个无需训练的混合量子-经典框架，用于可复现的全转录组聚类。KQE-2将细胞映射到无纠缠的量子态，使得能够在经典硬件上进行精确的特征评估，并在量子处理器上直接检查。在理论上，我们证明了消除纠缠是局部限制单量子比特特征方差的必要且充分条件。在实践中，虽然重新训练scVI使14%的细胞发生偏移并改变了稀有类型标记和药物靶点，但KQE-2在多次运行中提供了相同的生物学结果。在标准高变基因上，仅量子编码就将发育中皮层的准确率从0.61提高到0.79。KQE-2可在一台服务器上扩展到1140万个细胞核，在十个完整图谱中的八个上优于所比较的方法（在两个上处于最佳方法的运行间范围内），并且即使在标准下游聚类下也在六个上领先。

extra.description: Current single-cell clustering pipelines discard most genes and can yield inconsistent clusters across random seeds. We introduce KQE-2, a training-free hybrid quantum-classical framework for reproducible whole-transcriptome clustering. KQE-2 maps cells into entanglement-free quantum states, enabling exact feature evaluation on classical hardware and direct checks on a quantum processor. Theoretically, we prove that removing entanglement is necessary and sufficient to bound single-qubit feature variance locally. Practically, while retraining scVI shifted 14% of cells and altered rare-type markers and drug targets, KQE-2 delivered identical biology across runs. On standard highly variable genes, the quantum encoding alone raised accuracy on a developing cortex from 0.61 to 0.79. KQE-2 scales to 11.4 million nuclei on one server, outperforming the compared methods on eight of ten complete atlases (and within the best method's run-to-run range on two), and leads on six even under standard downstream clustering.

items.title: Collect for Coverage, Replay with Evidence: Adaptive and Efficient On-Policy Distillation for Long-Horizon Agents
items.title_zh: 为覆盖而收集，以证据重放：面向长时程智能体的自适应高效同策略蒸馏
items.summary_zh: 完全在线同策略蒸馏（OPD）对长时程智能体成本高昂，因为每次更新依赖新鲜环境 rollout。前缀重放通过从存储历史中采样当前学生响应提供高效替代，减少长尾 rollout 的空闲时间，并允许每条收集轨迹支持多次更新。然而，我们对完整前缀重放管线的分析识别出长时程设置中的两个局限。在轨迹收集中，仅教师轨迹错过学生诱导的历史，而更广泛的历史覆盖可能降低教师可靠性。在轨迹重用中，固定的基于位置的调度无法识别可能出现在任意轨迹深度的关键决策。我们引入CARE-OPD（Collect for coverAge, Replay with Evidence）来解决这两个局限。学生种子教师补全和响应级置信度门控扩大历史覆盖同时过滤不可靠更新。事后重放分配随后使用下游执行证据选择有影响的轮次。在长时程任务软件工程和深度研究中，CARE-OPD优于在线OPD和先前前缀重放基线。在SWE-bench Veri

extra.description: Fully online on-policy distillation (OPD) is costly for long-horizon agents because each update depends on fresh environment rollouts. Prefix replay offers an efficient alternative by sampling current-student responses from stored histories, reducing idle time for long-tail rollouts and allowing each collected trajectory to support multiple updates. However, our analysis of the complete prefix replay pipeline identifies two limitations in long-horizon settings. In trajectory collection, teacher-only trajectories miss student-induced histories, while broader history coverage can reduce teacher reliability. In trajectory reuse, fixed position-based schedules cannot identify critical decisions that may occur at any trajectory depth. We introduce CARE-OPD (Collect for coverAge, Replay with Evidence) to address both limitations. Student-seeded teacher completions and response-level confidence gating expand history coverage while filtering unreliable updates. Hindsight replay allocation then uses downstream execution evidence to select consequential turns. Across long-horizon tasks Software Engineering and Deep Research, CARE-OPD outperforms online OPD and prior prefix replay baselines. On SWE-bench Verified, it raises task success to 59.5% while reducing end-to-end training time by 45% and environment actions by 44% relative to asynchronous online OPD.

items.title: A gene informed benchmark for BioScoring of pathology foundation models
items.title_zh: 面向病理基础模型BioScoring的基因知情基准
items.summary_zh: 病理基础模型通常通过分类和检索等下游任务性能进行比较。虽然此类基准衡量模型有多大用处，但它们不提供模型所代表生物学的洞见。我们引入BioScore，一个量化图像编码器捕获细胞身份程度的基准，以同一组织的空间转录组学作为参考。稀疏自编码器将编码器的patch嵌入拆分为稀疏特征，我们将其聚类为固定数量的组。BioScore随后测量，对于由标记基因定义的52种细胞身份中的每一种，某一组在组织上跟随该身份表达的特异性程度。由于自编码器训练完全无监督，匹配表明模型仅从图像就代表了该细胞身份。我们对8个病理基础模型和3个自然图像模型评分。每个病理模型得分都高于每个自然图像模型（0.299–0.371 vs 0.214–0.232），配对检验将病理模型分为三个层级。与监督探针不同，BioScore无需标签，从数据构建参考，甚至可从少量切片评分，但其对编码器的排名与探针相同。其按身份分解表明每个编码器捕获

extra.description: Pathology foundation models are usually compared by their performance on downstream tasks such as classification and retrieval. While such benchmarks measure how useful a model is, they provide no insight into the biology it represents. We introduce BioScore, a benchmark that quantifies how well an image encoder captures cell identities, with spatial transcriptomics of the same tissue as the reference. A sparse autoencoder splits the encoder's patch embeddings into sparse features, which we cluster into a fixed number of groups. BioScore then measures, for each of 52 cell identities defined by marker genes, how specifically one group follows the identity's expression over the tissue. Because the autoencoder training is fully unsupervised, a match shows that the model represents the cell identity from the image alone. We score 8 pathology foundation models and 3 natural-image models. Every pathology model scores above every natural-image model (0.299--0.371 \vs 0.214--0.232), and paired tests separate three tiers among the pathology models. Unlike a supervised probe, BioScore needs no labels, builds its reference from the data and scores even from few sections, yet it ranks the encoders as a probe does. Its per-identity breakdown indicates which cell identities each encoder captures or misses.

items.title: Resolving cell states in spatial transcriptomics with SCATTER
items.title_zh: 用SCATTER解析空间转录组学中的细胞状态
items.summary_zh: 一个捕获spot可包含来自多种细胞类型的转录本。spot之间的差异可能反映细胞类型比例变化、某一细胞类型内表达变化，或两者兼有，使得从混合计数推断局部细胞类型表达困难。我们开发SCATTER，从空间转录组计数、坐标和注释单细胞参考数据估计每个spot每种细胞类型的比例和相对表达谱。SCATTER使用局部空间上下文加权参考细胞谱，然后联合拟合所得谱和细胞类型比例以重建spot计数。Cell2location估计正则化比例。拟合后，SCATTER使用学习的基因特异性校准因子和拟合比例在细胞类型间分配观察计数。在由成像数据构建的五个伪spot基准中，与DestVI、PANDA和STged成对比较时，SCATTER在82.8-99.8%的评估基因–细胞类型对中与实测表达的跨spot相关性更高。在乳腺癌Xenium数据中，它恢复了与肿瘤邻域和调控子评分相关的基因表达。在乳腺癌Visium数据中，推断

extra.description: A capture spot can contain transcripts from multiple cell types. Differences between spots may reflect changes in cell-type proportions, expression within a cell type, or both, making local cell-type expression difficult to infer from mixed counts. We developed SCATTER to estimate cell-type proportions and relative expression profiles for each cell type at each spot from spatial transcriptomic counts, coordinates, and annotated single-cell reference data. SCATTER weights reference cell profiles using local spatial context, then jointly fits the resulting profiles and cell-type proportions to reconstruct spot counts. Cell2location estimates regularize the proportions. After fitting, SCATTER uses learned gene-specific calibration factors and fitted proportions to allocate observed counts among cell types. In five pseudo-spot benchmarks constructed from imaging data, SCATTER achieved higher cross-spot correlations with measured expression for 82.8-99.8% of evaluated gene-cell type pairs in pairwise comparisons with DestVI, PANDA, and STged. In breast cancer Xenium data, it recovered gene expression associated with the tumor neighborhood and regulon scores. In breast cancer Visium data, inferred stromal and macrophage expression showed distinct associations with neighborhood malignant cell proportions. In multiple sclerosis brain tissue, SCATTER recovered lesion-associated glial expression programs. In colorectal cancer Visium HD data, it mapped cell-type-specific programs at the invasive front and ranked candidate ligand-receptor pairs. SCATTER enables analysis of spatial expression variation within cell types from mixed tissue measurements.

items.title: Cancer multi-omics joint dimension reduction leads to reliable and interpretable survival predictions
items.title_zh: 癌症多组学联合降维带来可靠且可解释的生存预测
items.summary_zh: 多组学研究越来越频繁，特别适合解密癌症中失调的复杂性。在此背景下，通过可解释方法改进预后可提供更好的患者分层，并帮助识别新的预后生物标志物和治疗靶点。然而多组学数据通常非常高维（患者少/变量多）。高维性的一种可能解决方案是联合降维（JDR）方法，从多组学数据计算低维潜在空间。在这项工作中，我们在18个不同的TCGA癌症数据集上对12种JDR方法进行基准测试。生存预测通过两步过程实现：估计低维多组学潜在空间，然后有或没有额外临床数据进行生存预测。我们必须为4种方法配备预测新患者生存的能力。结果表明JDR方法可以通过临床数据改善生存预测，并匹配单独临床数据的预测性能，不同癌症之间差异很大。在JDR方法中，JIVE和RGCCA表现出优越性能。在随后的bootstrap分析中，JDR方法识别跨癌症的可靠预后生物标志物。我们提出了此类标志物在低级别胶质瘤中的临床相关解释。可复现代码可在https:/

extra.description: Multi-omics studies are becoming more and more frequent, and are especially suited to decrypt the complexity of dysregulation happening in cancer. In this context, improving prognostication through interpretable methods could provide better patient stratification and help identify new prognostic biomarkers and therapeutic targets. Multi-omics data are however very often high-dimensional (few patients/high number of variables). A possible solution to high-dimensionality is Joint Dimension Reduction (JDR) methods, which compute a low-dimensional latent space from multi-omics data. In this work, we benchmark 12 JDR methods on 18 different TCGA cancer datasets. Survival prediction is achieved through a two-step process: the estimation of a low-dimensional multi-omics latent space followed by survival prediction with or without additional clinical data. We had to equip 4 methods with the ability to predict the survival of new patients. Results reveal that JDR methods can improve survival prediction with clinical data, and match the predictive performance of clinical data alone, with a high variability between different cancers. Among JDR methods, JIVE and RGCCA show superior performance. In a subsequent bootstrap analysis, JDR methods identify reliable prognostic biomarkers across cancers. We propose a clinically relevant interpretation of such markers on Low-Grade Glioma. Reproducible codes are available on https://github.com/vlegoff/MultiOBenchmark.

items.title: GaLF-ST: Gaussian Latent Fields for Spatial Transcriptomics Reconstruction
items.title_zh: GaLF-ST：用于空间转录组重建的高斯潜在场
items.summary_zh: 空间转录组（ST）在已知组织位置测量基因表达，以揭示组织组织和细胞功能。表达预测需要建模局部空间关系和基因间关联。现有方法通常使用坐标网络建模表达，没有显式空间参数化。为解决ST有限空间采样和稀疏表达观测，一些方法先拟合中间嵌入再训练表达预测器，但适合表达重建的潜在表示可能难以从空间坐标预测。两个训练阶段可能对潜在表示提出不同要求。本文提出GaLF-ST，一种高斯潜在场方法，其中可学习高斯中心和各向异性协方差决定每个位置潜在向量的权重。共享非线性解码器将其加权平均映射为多基因表达。在GaLF-ST中，观测表达误差联合更新高斯几何、潜在向量和解码器参数。我们进一步建立跨七个数据集组和三个留出比例的统基准，使用相同位置、划分、基因面板和评分规则比较GaLF-ST与四种代表性方法。跨组织和观测密度，GaLF-ST实现领先的整体重建性能，从有限观测中恢复空间基因表达模式并保留组织域，同时大幅减少运

extra.description: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) measures gene expression at known tissue locations to reveal tissue organization and cellular function. Expression prediction requires modeling both local spatial relationships and associations among genes. Existing methods typically model expression using coordinate networks without explicit spatial parameterization. To address limited spatial sampling and sparse expression observations of ST, some methods firstly fit intermediate embeddings and then train expression predictors, but a latent representation suited to expression reconstruction may be difficult to predict from spatial coordinates. The two training stages can impose different demands on the latent representation. In this paper, we propose GaLF-ST, a Gaussian latent field method in which learnable Gaussian centers and anisotropic covariances determine the weights of latent vectors at each location. A shared nonlinear decoder maps their weighted average to multigene expression. In GaLF-ST, observed expression error jointly updates the Gaussian geometry, latent vectors, and decoder parameters. We further establish a unified benchmark across seven dataset groups and three held-out fractions, comparing GaLF-ST with four representative methods using the same locations, splits, gene panels, and scoring rules. Across tissues and observation densities, GaLF-ST achieves leading overall reconstruction performance, recovering spatial gene expression patterns and preserving tissue domains from limited observations while substantially reducing runtime and GPU memory usage.

items.title: An Explainable and Scalable Hierarchical Tensor Framework for Integrating Multi-Omics and Digital Pathomics
items.title_zh: 一个用于整合多组学和数字病理学的可解释且可扩展的分层张量框架
items.summary_zh: 背景：精准肿瘤学需要整合异质分子和病理数据，但许多融合模型提供有限的生物学基础可解释性且难以处理缺失模态。方法：我们展示分层可解释张量融合（HIT-Fuse），整合六种模态：体细胞拷贝数变异、DNA甲基化、RNA测序、microRNA表达、RPPA蛋白丰度和视觉transformer衍生的病理组学，跨越四个TCGA队列（胶质瘤、肺腺癌、乳腺癌和肾癌）。模态特异性自编码器压缩高维输入，随后进行两阶段CP张量分解。缺失潜在模态使用临床协变量和观察到的组学重建，以扩展队列并重新训练下游模型。数学回溯机制实现全局和局部xAI归因。结果：HIT-Fuse识别出具有显著生存分层的不同潜在亚组，在胶质瘤、乳腺癌和肾癌队列中，无论完整还是重建模态。队列扩展产生队列特异性增益，包括胶质瘤加权F1相对增加56.4%。针对DepMap CRISPR筛选、miRTarBase和RPPA注释的生物学验证支持所有四个

extra.description: Background: Precision oncology requires integration of heterogeneous molecular and pathology data, yet many fusion models offer limited biologically grounded interpretability and struggle with missing modalities. Methods: We present Hierarchical Interpretable Tensor Fusion (HIT-Fuse), integrating six modalities: somatic copy number variation, DNA methylation, RNA sequencing, microRNA expression, RPPA protein abundance, and vision transformer-derived pathomics across four TCGA cohorts (glioma, lung adenocarcinoma, breast, and kidney cancer). Modality-specific autoencoders compress high-dimensional inputs, followed by two-stage CP tensor decomposition. Missing latent modalities are reconstructed using clinical covariates and observed omics to expand cohorts and retrain downstream models. A mathematical traceback mechanism enables global and local xAI attributions. Results: HIT-Fuse identifies distinct latent subgroups with significant survival stratification in glioma, breast, and kidney cohorts, both with complete and reconstructed modalities. Cohort expansion yields cohort-specific gains, including a 56.4% relative increase in weighted F1 for glioma. Biological validation against DepMap CRISPR screens, miRTarBase and RPPA annotations supports decoded drivers across all four cohorts. Essential gene rates range from 6.2% in glioma to 7.6% in lung cancer; example drivers include ANAPC11, SNRPD1, PLK1 and RPL14. Of decoded miRNAs, 71-92% have miRTarBase regulatory support, while 77-84% of selected genes are covered in DepMap. Conclusions: HIT-Fuse combines hierarchical tensor fusion, missing-modality reconstruction and traceable attributions to support interpretable multi-omics and digital pathology-based cancer prognosis across heterogeneous cohorts.

items.title: HoloGene: Learning to Lift Sliced Spatial Transcriptomics to Holistic 3D Gene Fields
items.title_zh: HoloGene：学习将切片空间转录组学提升为整体3D基因场
items.summary_zh: 空间转录组学（ST）提供空间分辨的基因表达测量，但大多数3D ST数据集作为独立处理的2D切片获取。计算方法涵盖切片配准和整合、显式或生成插值以及坐标场建模。在最后一类中，隐式神经表示（INR）提供连续、可坐标查询的参数化，但标准各向同性坐标编码未明确反映连续切片测量在平面内密集而沿轴向稀疏。我们提出 HoloGene，一个各向异性条件 INR 框架，用于从预配准 ST 切片估计连续3D基因表达场。其核心贡献是一种采集感知的因子分解，使用已建立的 GAE、FiLM、伪标签监督和 CORAL 组件将密集平面内合成与稀疏轴向演化耦合。HoloGene 将高维表达谱压缩为图自编码器潜在流形，使用伪标签衍生的签名条件提供粗略切片内上下文，并应用深度依赖的 FiLM 调制来建模轴向变异。签名分层相关对齐正则化器鼓励潜在特征中的跨切片协方差对齐。使用留出测量切片作为横截面参考，HoloGene 与通用

extra.description: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) provides spatially resolved gene expression measurements, but most 3D ST datasets are acquired as independently processed 2D sections. Computational approaches span slice registration and integration, explicit or generative interpolation, and coordinate-field modeling. Within the last family, implicit neural representations (INRs) offer a continuous, coordinate-queryable parameterization, but standard isotropic coordinate encodings do not explicitly reflect that serial-section measurements are dense in-plane and sparse along the axial direction. We present HoloGene, an anisotropic conditional INR framework for estimating continuous 3D gene-expression fields from pre-registered ST sections. Its central contribution is an acquisition-aware factorization that couples dense in-plane synthesis with sparse axial evolution using established GAE, FiLM, pseudo-label supervision, and CORAL components. HoloGene compresses high-dimensional expression profiles into a graph-autoencoder latent manifold, uses pseudo-label-derived signature conditioning to provide coarse intra-section context, and applies depth-dependent FiLM modulation to model axial variation. A signature-stratified correlation-alignment regularizer encourages cross-slice covariance alignment in latent features. Using held-out measured sections as cross-sectional references, HoloGene improves reconstruction accuracy and biological preservation metrics compared with general-purpose INRs and adapted spatial-transcriptomics baselines. These results support anisotropic conditional modeling as a practical strategy for estimating 3D expression fields from discontinuous ST sections. Code is available at https://github.com/Szym29/HoloGene.

items.title: Bridging Graph and Pairwise Learning for Gene Regulatory Network Inference from scRNA-seq Data
items.title_zh: 融合图学习与成对学习，从scRNA-seq数据推断基因调控网络
items.summary_zh: 动机：基因调控网络（GRNs）捕捉转录因子（TFs）调控基因的潜在相互作用。基于基因表达数据，现有GRN推断方法大致分为两类：基于图的方法，将GRN建模为整体图；基于成对的方法，将GRN分解为单个TF-靶基因对进行建模。然而，每种方法都有局限性，而这些局限恰恰是另一方的优势。基于图的方法因依赖单一训练图而容易过拟合，而成对方法则受益于丰富的TF-靶基因训练对。相反，成对方法忽略了全局拓扑结构，而这对全面捕捉调控机制至关重要。结果：为解决这些局限，我们提出scGPL，一个端到端统一框架，联合建模全局调控拓扑和局部相互作用。scGPL从全局调控图中提取宏观特征，并引入动态的、重要性引导的子图采样机制以捕捉细粒度局部依赖。通过融合全局表示与子图增强的局部特征，我们的框架弥合了两种范式之间的差距，既纳入必要的全图拓扑依赖，又保留成对方法的数据丰富优势。在七个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，scGPL持

extra.description: Motivation: Gene regulatory networks (GRNs) capture the underlying interactions through which transcription factors (TFs) regulate genes. Based on gene expression data, existing GRN inference approaches generally fall into two categories: graph-based methods, which model the GRN as a whole graph, and pairwise-based methods, which decompose the GRN into individual TF-target gene pairs for modeling. However, each approach exhibits limitations that are precisely the strengths of its counterpart. Graph-based methods tend to overfit due to their reliance on a single training graph, whereas pairwise-based methods benefit from abundant TF-target training pairs. In contrast, pairwise-based methods overlook the global topological structure, which is essential for comprehensively capturing regulatory mechanisms. Results: To address these limitations, we propose scGPL, an end-to-end unified framework that jointly models global regulatory topology and local interactions. scGPL extracts macro-level features from the global regulatory graph and introduces a dynamic, importance-guided subgraph sampling mechanism to capture fine-grained local dependencies. By fusing global representations with subgraph-enhanced local features, our framework bridges the gap between the two paradigms, incorporating essential whole-graph topological dependencies while retaining the data abundance advantage of pairwise methods. Extensive experiments on seven benchmark datasets demonstrate that scGPL consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance, with up to 13.7% improvement over the strongest baseline, validating the effectiveness of our integrative design. Availability and implementation: The source code is maintained on GitHub (https://github.com/talent-hang/scGPL), and the datasets and versioned releases are archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21608485 for reproducibility.

items.title: Publications as benchmarks: auditing AI agents on spatial transcriptomics alignment
items.title_zh: 出版物作为基准：审计AI智能体在空间转录组对齐上的表现
items.summary_zh: AI智能体正越来越多地自动化数据分析，但负责任的采用需要可靠的性能评估，这在专业科学领域成本高昂。我们引入了一个框架，将科学出版物转化为AI智能体可审计的基准，并展示了其在空间转录组对齐任务上的应用。在121个任务、16个基线方法和六个AI智能体中，最佳智能体（GPT-6-Astra和Gemini-4-Argon）在80%的任务上匹配或优于所有基线，通常使用令人惊讶的简单启发式方法。智能体性能对提示和访问预安装包具有鲁棒性。基准构建还揭示了先前工作中的错误和当前评估指标中的捷径。最后，我们表明智能体生成的解决方案可以蒸馏成一个可重用的程序，在未见数据上排名前10%的基线方法。我们的框架提供了一种可扩展的方式，通过利用和压力测试现有论文和指标来评估专业科学领域中的AI智能体。

extra.description: AI agents are increasingly automating data analysis, but responsible adoption requires reliable performance evaluation, which is costly in specialized scientific domains. We introduce a framework that translates scientific publications into auditable benchmarks for AI agents and demonstrate its use on spatial transcriptomics alignment tasks. Across 121 tasks, 16 baseline methods, and six AI agents, the best agents (GPT-6-Astra and Gemini-4-Argon) matched or outperformed all baselines on 80% of tasks, often using surprisingly simple heuristics. Agent performance was robust to prompting and access to pre-installed packages. Benchmark construction also uncovered errors in prior work and shortcuts in current evaluation metrics. Finally, we show that agent-generated solutions can be distilled into a reusable program that ranks in the top 10% of baseline methods on unseen data. Our framework offers a scalable way to evaluate AI agents in specialized scientific domains by leveraging and stress-testing existing papers and metrics.

items.title: Bayesian Learning of Spatially Heterogeneous Causal Structure in Spatial Transcriptomics
items.title_zh: 空间转录组学中空间异质因果结构的贝叶斯学习
items.summary_zh: 空间转录组学保留了每个表达谱的位置，使得研究基因调控网络在组织内如何差异成为可能。在组织的不同区域，调控关系可能变化甚至方向反转，因此识别特定病理区域中的因果关系可为治疗靶点提供洞见。我们提出SpaDAG，一种学习空间变化因果有向无环图的贝叶斯方法。通过在组织的三角剖分上定义图，SpaDAG允许每条边具有自己的空间模式，甚至在不同区域间方向反转。我们证明这些图仍然完全可识别，并开发了一种MCMC采样器，通过单次移动反转整个连通区域上的一条边来高效探索它们。SpaDAG在有和无方向反转的模拟中均优于竞争方法。在跨越肾细胞癌及邻近肾脏的切片中，SpaDAG发现两种组织中关系差异很大，肿瘤中的关系集中在与治疗靶点相关的基因上。在其中两个基因之间，它识别出一种方向在肿瘤边界处反转的关系，从而生成关于其区域特异性耦合的假设。本文的补充材料和代码可在线获取。

extra.description: Spatial transcriptomics preserves the location of each expression profile, making it possible to study how gene regulatory networks differ within a tissue. Across regions of a tissue, regulatory relationships may vary and even reverse direction, so identifying the causal relationships in a specific pathological region can provide insight into therapeutic targets. We propose SpaDAG, a Bayesian method for learning spatially varying causal directed acyclic graphs. By defining the graphs on a triangulation of the tissue, SpaDAG allows each edge to have its own spatial pattern and even to reverse direction across regions. We show that the graphs nonetheless remain fully identifiable, and develop an MCMC sampler that explores them efficiently by reversing an edge over an entire connected region in a single move. SpaDAG outperforms competing methods in simulations with and without direction reversals. In a section spanning a renal cell carcinoma and the adjacent kidney, SpaDAG finds largely different relationships in the two tissues, with those in the tumor concentrated on genes associated with therapeutic targets. Between two of these genes, it identifies a relationship whose direction reverses across the tumor boundary, generating hypotheses about their region-specific coupling. Supplementary materials and code for this article are available online.

items.title: SCOPE: Single-Cell Omics Prediction from Histology via RNA-Protein Prior Enhancement
items.title_zh: SCOPE：通过RNA-蛋白质先验增强从组织学预测单细胞组学。
items.summary_zh: 从常规H&E图像预测细胞的RNA和蛋白质含量可将空间分子谱分析扩展到现有切片档案。然而，H&E-空间蛋白质组学和H&E-空间转录组学配对数据集均受可用标记物数量和高质量、细胞分辨数据不足的限制。我们提出SCOPE（通过RNA-蛋白质先验增强的单细胞组学预测），一个统一框架，利用RNA和蛋白质之间的生物学互补信息来解决单组学监督可用性有限的问题。我们的关键见解是，尽管RNA和蛋白质代表不同的分子模态，但它们的生物学关系提供了有价值的共享知识，可有益于单组学预测任务。为此，SCOPE引入生物学信息生物标志物先验以增强共享基因水平表示，通过基因-蛋白质对应和分子关联实现跨RNA和蛋白质模态的知识转移。通过利用这些互补关系，SCOPE使两个预测任务都能受益于富含跨组学生物学知识的共享骨干。此外，其生物标志物相关性设计便于预测未见标记物，将空间分辨分子谱分析扩展到直接监督目标之外。在涵盖16个器官的

extra.description: Predicting the RNA and protein content of cells from routine H&E images could extend spatial molecular profiling to existing slide archives. However, both H&E-spatial proteomics and H&E-spatial transcriptomics paired datasets are limited by the number of available markers and the insufficient availability of high-quality, cell-resolved data. We present SCOPE (Single-Cell Omics Prediction via RNA-protein prior Enhancement), a unified framework that leverages biologically complementary information between RNA and proteins to address the limited availability of single-omics supervision. Our key insight is that, although RNA and proteins represent distinct molecular modalities, their biological relationships provide valuable shared knowledge that can benefit single-omics prediction tasks. To this end, SCOPE introduces biologically informed biomarker priors to enhance shared gene-level representations, enabling knowledge transfer across RNA and protein modalities through gene-protein correspondence and molecular associations. By exploiting these complementary relationships, SCOPE enables both prediction tasks to benefit from a shared backbone enriched with cross-omics biological knowledge. Furthermore, its biomarker correlation design facilitates the prediction of unseen markers, extending spatially resolved molecular profiling beyond directly supervised targets. Across test datasets spanning 16 organs, SCOPE improves the average RNA Pearson correlation over the strongest baseline by 8.8%. On two external protein cohorts, it improves the average Pearson correlation over the strongest baseline by 9.7% for seen markers and 11.9% for unseen markers.

items.title: ST-FateFlow: Continuous Gene-Spatial Reconstruction with Differentiation-Potential Learning from Time-Resolved Spatial Transcriptomics
items.title_zh: ST-FateFlow：从时间分辨空间转录组学通过分化潜能学习进行连续基因-空间重建
items.summary_zh: 时间分辨空间转录组学通过测量细胞状态及其跨时间的空间组织，提供动态生物过程的强大视图。然而，破坏性分析和实验成本将观察限制在从独立样本收集的少数离散时间点，且跨时间没有已知的细胞配对。这使得难以重建未观察阶段的基因表达和组织组织，并表征分化相关动态。在此，我们引入 ST-FateFlow，一个用于连续基因-空间动态和分化潜能学习的流匹配框架。ST-FateFlow 联合学习基因表达和空间坐标速度场，能够插值缺失时间点并连续建模转录演化和组织重塑。同时，它独立学习时间条件分化潜能，其值沿推断的分化进程组织细胞状态，并支持分化相关转录变化的分析。在多个时间分辨空间转录组学数据集中，ST-FateFlow 有效捕捉协调的基因表达和空间动态。案例研究进一步表明，学习的潜能景观与已知发育和再生轨迹一致，并有助于识别与分化进展相关的候选基因。

extra.description: Time-resolved spatial transcriptomics provides a powerful view of dynamic biological processes by measuring cellular states together with their spatial organization across time. However, destructive profiling and experimental cost restrict observations to a few discrete time points collected from independent samples, with no known cell pairing across time. This makes it difficult to reconstruct gene expression and tissue organization at unobserved stages and to characterize differentiation-associated dynamics. Here, we introduce ST-FateFlow, a flow-matching framework for continuous gene-spatial dynamics and differentiation-potential learning. ST-FateFlow jointly learns gene-expression and spatial-coordinate velocity fields, enabling interpolation of missing time points and continuous modeling of transcriptional evolution and tissue remodeling. In parallel, it independently learns a time-conditioned differentiation potential, whose values organize cell states along inferred differentiation progressions and support the analysis of differentiation-associated transcriptional changes. Across multiple time-resolved spatial transcriptomics datasets, ST-FateFlow effectively captures coordinated gene-expression and spatial dynamics. Case studies further show that the learned potential landscapes are consistent with known developmental and regenerative trajectories and help identify candidate genes associated with differentiation progression.

items.title: Spectrum Adaptation of AI-Native Autoencoder Communications with Transfer Learning
items.title_zh: AI原生自编码器通信的频谱自适应与迁移学习
items.summary_zh: 端到端物理层学习用自编码器（AE）取代单独的调制、编码和检测操作，该自编码器由发射机和接收机处联合训练的编码器–解码器对组成。本文研究使用AE的AI原生通信，并量化信道模型中训练–测试失配的敏感性。仅在AWGN信道上训练的模型在匹配条件下达到低误码率（BER），但在具有实际前端损伤的Rayleigh衰落上严重退化。为减少适应新信道条件所需的时间和能量，我们提出一种低延迟迁移学习过程，从AWGN预训练系统开始，仅微调发射机和接收机层的一小部分子集，同时冻结其余部分。我们进一步将层选择表述为预算约束优化问题，识别适应期间要更新的最具信息量的参数。这在适应轻量前端到衰落和损伤诱导的混合时保留学习的信号几何和深层决策结构。对于AE通信，我们显示部分更新消除失配诱导的错误底并接近完全重训练模型的BER。我们提供逐层研究并量化资源–性能权衡，显示适度适应大幅降低BER，同时减少训练时间、乘加（MAC）

extra.description: End-to-end physical-layer learning replaces separate modulation, coding, and detection operations with an autoencoder (AE) that consists of a jointly trained encoder-decoder pair at the transmitter and the receiver. This paper studies AI-native communications with AEs and quantifies the sensitivity to training-test mismatch in channel models. Models trained only on an AWGN channel achieve low bit error rates (BERs) under matched conditions but degrade severely on Rayleigh fading with practical front-end impairments. To reduce the time and energy required to adapt to new channel conditions, we propose a low-latency transfer-learning procedure that starts from an AWGN-pretrained system and fine-tunes only a small subset of transmitter and receiver layers while freezing the remainder. We further formulate layer selection as a budget-constrained optimization problem that identifies the most informative parameters to update during adaptation. This preserves the learned signal geometry and the deep decision structure while adapting lightweight front ends to fading- and impairment-induced mixing. For AE communications, we show that partial updates remove the mismatch-induced error floor and approach the BER of fully retrained models. We provide a layer-wise study and quantify resource-performance trade-offs, showing that modest adaptation substantially reduces BER while cutting training time, multiply-accumulate (MAC) operations, energy consumption, and the fraction of updated parameters for resource-efficient implementation.

items.title: Diverse Alternative Reasoning Traces for Hard Math Problems
items.title_zh: 面向困难数学问题的多样替代推理轨迹
items.summary_zh: 对大型语言模型（LLM）进行数学推理后训练通常依赖最终答案通过验证器的被接受轨迹。然而，对于困难数学问题，此类轨迹在独立蒙特卡洛（MC）采样下可能稀少。为解决此问题，我们提出多样替代推理轨迹（DART），一种轨迹挖掘方法，从被拒绝轨迹开始，将其分解为推理步骤，并按位置加权不确定性排序。然后使用参考答案引导和元思维为高排名步骤生成刻意不同的替代候选，再完成所得轨迹。在贪心未解决的DeepMath-103K问题上，DART在匹配生成轨迹数量下比MC采样多恢复37%的问题。其每恢复问题的估计生成成本几乎相同，而每接受轨迹成本低30%。在DART挖掘的轨迹上后训练Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct在MATH-500和AIME基准的六项评估中五项达到最高点估计。这些结果表明，用DART重新审视被拒绝轨迹可扩大问题覆盖并提供有效后训练数据。

extra.description: Post-training large language models (LLMs) for mathematical reasoning often relies on accepted traces whose final answers pass a verifier. For hard math problems, however, such traces can be rare under independent Monte Carlo (MC) sampling. To address this, we propose Diverse Alternative Reasoning Traces (DART), a trace-mining method that starts from a rejected trace, decomposes it into reasoning steps, and ranks them by position-weighted uncertainty. It then generates deliberately distinct alternative candidates for highly ranked steps using reference-answer guidance and a meta-thought before completing the resulting traces. On greedy-unsolved DeepMath-103K problems, DART recovers 37% more problems than MC sampling at a matched number of generated traces. Its estimated generation cost per recovered problem is nearly identical, while its cost per accepted trace is 30% lower. Post-training Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct on traces mined by DART achieves the highest point estimate in five of six evaluations across MATH-500 and AIME benchmarks. These results demonstrate that revisiting rejected traces with DART can expand problem coverage and provide effective post-training data.

items.title: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer
items.title_zh: 循环混合Transformer
items.summary_zh: 循环Transformer通过跨循环重用共享层来提升表达力，但以效率为代价。推动其表达力-效率前沿需要重新思考连接相邻循环的核心机制：Transformer循环之间应该传递什么？我们引入循环混合Transformer（MoLT），其循环混合注意力（MoLA）使用键和值（KV）作为记忆，跨深度和循环选择性重用。在循环残差下，MoLT-R保留残差流并跨循环读取局部KV以提升表达力。在循环KV下，MoLT-KV改为从嵌入重新开始，并在较早位置读取当前循环局部KV和前一循环记忆KV以提升效率。MoLT-KV消除了同位置跨循环依赖，并与循环强制用于并行训练相结合，解锁超越训练循环视野的单次遍历循环混合（MoL）解码。为平衡效率和质量，我们引入U形MoLT（U-MoLT），它将记忆构建与预测读出分离，并跳过未使用的解码器遍历而不改变预测。在400B token预训练中，U-MoLT在700M/1.5B

extra.description: Looped Transformers boost expressivity by reusing shared layers across loops, yet at the cost of efficiency. Pushing their expressivity-efficiency frontier requires rethinking the core mechanism connecting adjacent loops: What should be passed as a Transformer loops? We introduce Mixture-of-Loops Transformer (MoLT), whose Mixture-of-Loops Attention (MoLA) uses keys and values (KV) as memory for selective reuse across depths and loops. Under loop residual, MoLT-R retains the residual stream and reads local KV across loops for expressivity. Under loop KV, MoLT-KV instead restarts from embeddings and reads current-loop local KV with preceding-loop memory KV at earlier positions for efficiency. MoLT-KV eliminates same-position cross-loop dependence and, paired with loop forcing for parallel training, unlocks single-traversal Mixture-of-Loops (MoL) decoding beyond the training loop horizon. To balance efficiency and quality, we introduce U-shaped MoLT (U-MoLT), which separates memory construction from prediction readout and skips unused decoder traversals without changing predictions. In 400B-token pretraining, U-MoLT outperforms OLMo3 across 700M/1.5B dense and 3B MoE models, achieving 1.7x validation cross-entropy (CE) token efficiency at 700M while improving 3B MoE 10-domain perplexity by 0.75 and 10-task accuracy by 2.1 percentage points. In 100B-token continued pretraining of Qwen3.5-0.8B-Base, our U-MoLT adaptation lowers CE on all 11 domains over the matched baseline with 1.4x mean token efficiency. At inference, U-MoLT with MoL-Hybrid-2 matches non-looped OLMo3 latency at 996.6 vs. 1,000.6 ms on S-size (~113M) models. Code is available at https://github.com/hustvl/MoLT

items.title: $μ$-Bench: Benchmarking Multi-User Task Completion in Shared Interaction Voice Agents
items.title_zh: $μ$-Bench：共享交互语音代理中多用户任务完成的基准测试
items.summary_zh: 共享空间中的语音代理必须满足相互依赖的多用户请求，同时维护每用户权限、隐私和任务约束。现有评估在参与者整个会话中做出反应时覆盖有限。我们引入$μ$-Bench，一个用于闭环、全双工多用户语音交互中联合任务完成的基准。模拟参与者从隔离的目标、知识和权限档案出发行动，适应代理的语音和工具结果。跨20个领域，100个场景变化组大小、声学和后续需求，形成800个案例（408个工具增强，392个无工具）。联合任务成功（JTS）要求所有用户目标、隐私边界和终止状态共同成立，而纯JTS进一步禁止未经授权的工具调用；归因、线程和协调（ATC）诊断定位失败。在13个语音代理中，专有系统在无工具和工具增强成功率上分别达到62.24%和65.44%的峰值，而开放权重模型仍低于20%。ATC诊断显示开放权重模型主要在多轮归因和线程方面落后，受控对比揭示较大组在有能力系统中一致降低联合任务成功率。通过将反应式多用户

extra.description: Voice agents in shared spaces must satisfy interdependent multi-user requests while upholding per-user authority, privacy, and task constraints. Existing evaluations offer limited coverage when participants react throughout a session. We introduce $μ$-Bench, a benchmark for joint task completion in closed-loop, full-duplex multi-user voice interaction. Simulated participants act from isolated profiles of goals, knowledge, and permissions, adapting to the agent's speech and tool outcomes. Across 20 domains, 100 scenarios vary group size, acoustics, and follow-up demands to form 800 cases (408 tool-augmented, 392 tool-free). Joint Task Success (JTS) requires all user goals, privacy boundaries, and terminal states to hold jointly, while Pure JTS further disallows unauthorized tool calls; Attribution, Threading, and Coordination (ATC) diagnostics localize failures. Across 13 voice agents, proprietary systems peak at 62.24\% tool-free and 65.44\% tool-augmented success, while open-weight models remain below 20\%. ATC diagnostics show that open-weight models lag primarily in multi-turn attribution and threading, and controlled contrasts reveal that larger groups consistently degrade joint task success across capable systems. By coupling reactive multi-user simulation with verifiable session-level outcomes, $μ$-Bench provides a rigorous testbed for shared voice agents.

items.title: Genome architecture and duplication-associated functional diversification in the carnivorous plant Sarracenia purpurea
items.title_zh: 食虫植物紫瓶子草的基因组结构和复制相关功能多样化
items.summary_zh: 复杂性状的反复演化提出了一个问题：基因组如何在保持发育组织的同时产生生态新颖性。我们展示了食虫紫瓶子草（Sarracenia purpurea）的染色体级基因组组装和注释，并研究了两种对比基因复制模式如何塑造其基因组和功能库：古老多倍化，将重复基因留在保守染色体区域（同线重复），以及局部串联重复，产生相邻基因拷贝。我们在九种被子植物中比较这些复制类别。基因组显示出保守和碎片化重复区域的镶嵌，反映了古老多倍化后基因的差异保留和丢失以及后来的重构。与非食虫的猕猴桃（Actinidia）比较，识别出18个同线和9个串联基因本体（GO）生物过程术语-复制类别组合在Sarracenia中富集但在猕猴桃中未显著富集。同线富集包括分生组织维持、器官边界指定、角质层发育和激素调节；串联富集包括防御反应、氧化应激、茉莉酸生物合成、叶片衰老和寡肽转运。在食虫属Sarracenia、Nepenthes、Utri

extra.description: The repeated evolution of complex traits raises the question of how genomes generate ecological novelty while preserving developmental organization. We present a chromosome-scale genome assembly and annotation for the carnivorous purple pitcher plant, Sarracenia purpurea, and investigate how two contrasting modes of gene duplication have shaped its genome and functional repertoire: ancient polyploidy, which leaves duplicated genes in conserved chromosomal regions (syntenic duplicates), and local tandem duplication, which generates neighboring gene copies. We compare these duplication classes across nine angiosperms. The genome shows a mosaic of conserved and fractionated duplicated regions reflecting differential retention and loss of genes following ancient polyploidy and later restructuring. Comparison with noncarnivorous Actinidia (kiwifruit) identifies 18 syntenic and nine tandem Gene Ontology (GO) Biological Process term-duplication-class combinations enriched in Sarracenia but not significantly enriched in Actinidia. Syntenic enrichments include meristem maintenance, organ-boundary specification, cuticle development, and hormonal regulation; tandem enrichments include defense responses, oxidative stress, jasmonic-acid biosynthesis, leaf senescence, and oligopeptide transport. Across the carnivorous genera Sarracenia, Nepenthes, Utricularia, and Pinguicula, we identify 19 syntenic and two tandem-associated biological processes showing significant enrichment in all four lineages, revealing striking functional commonalities across multiple evolutionary origins of carnivory despite their divergent trap morphologies and ecological strategies. Among Sarracenia genes differentially expressed in at least one comparison of flower, pitcher-leaf, and root tissues, tandem-class genes exhibit larger maximum absolute expression differences and greater GO richness and effective breadth at matched numbers of annotated homologs. These results highlight the complementary evolutionary contributions of ancient genome duplication and local gene-family expansion to the developmental and ecological diversification of carnivorous plants.

items.title: 梁靖崑将赴俄超打球，怎样看待他的选择？对他职业生涯发展有哪些影响？
items.title_zh: 梁靖崑将赴俄超打球，怎样看待他的选择？对他职业生涯发展有哪些影响？
items.summary_zh: 中国乒乓球运动员梁靖崑28日向新华社记者证实，他已与火炬-天然气工业俱乐部达成加盟协议，将代表球队出战2026—2027赛季俄罗斯乒乓球超级联赛。按照赛程，他将于近期到达俄罗斯。 火炬-天然气工业队是俄罗斯乒坛传统劲旅，曾多次夺得欧洲冠军联赛冠军，奥恰洛夫、萨姆索诺夫等名将曾效力于此。新赛季该队与目前积分榜领跑的乌拉尔冶金队同处争冠集团，后者拥有达科·约奇克等欧洲顶尖选手。 梁靖崑1996年10月生，右手横板进攻型打法，2014年进入国家一队。2026年6月，梁靖崑出任国乒男队副队长。今年上半年他随队出征伦敦世乒赛，半决赛对阵法国选手艾利克斯·勒布伦、决赛首盘对阵张本智和，两次在0:2落后情况下完成逆转，决赛决胜局3:8落后连得8分翻盘，帮助国乒男团3:0横扫日本实现12连冠。 梁靖崑表示，选择这个阶段赴俄打球，是结合自身伤病恢复、竞技状态调整等作出的综合考量。国乒名将梁靖崑将赴俄超打球

items.title: 央行《大额存单管理办法》公布，个人投资人认购大额存单起点降为不低于10万元，如何解读？将带来哪些影响？
items.title_zh: 央行《大额存单管理办法》公布，个人投资人认购大额存单起点降为不低于10万元，如何解读？将带来哪些影响？
items.summary_zh: 11月27日，央行发布关于《大额存单管理办法（征求意见稿）》 公开征求意见的反馈，具体内容如下。 《大额存单管理办法（征求意见稿）》（以下简称《办法》）于2026年6月12日至7月12日面向社会公开征求意见。在征求期内收到的意见合并后共10条，基本已吸收采纳，意见主要集中在以下2个方面： 一、建议降低大额存单起点认购金额。 采纳情况：已予采纳。将大额存单起点认购金额修改为“个人投资人认购大额存单起点金额不低于10万元人民币，机构投资人认购大额存单起点金额不低于500万元人民币。” 二、建议进一步完善大额存单转让服务。 采纳情况：已予采纳。在第九条中增加表述“发行人应向持有人提示大额存单转让方式和转让规则，为持有人开展转让提供便利，并加强对转让行为的监测，维护大额存单转让秩序。”央行：降低大额存单起点认购金额

items.title: 雅迪、爱玛、九号等15家电动自行车企业被点名，部分企业涉违法出售不合格产品情况，哪些信息值得关注？

items.summary_zh: 记者今天了解到，市场监管总局对雅迪、台铃、爱玛、新日、小刀、绿源、金箭、九号、小牛、绿佳、绿驹、立马、极跃、赛鸽、极核等15家电动自行车企业进行集中约谈。 约谈指出，近期市场监管总局组织对电动自行车企业开展强制性产品认证（CCC认证）全覆盖飞行检查，发现有关企业质量主体责任落实不到位，质量保证能力欠缺，产品一致性管控不严，部分企业存在违反强制性国家标准出厂销售不合格产品的情况，扰乱市场秩序，侵害消费者合法权益，给人民群众生命财产安全带来风险隐患。 约谈要求，电动自行车企业要严格遵守《中华人民共和国产品质量法》《中华人民共和国标准化法》《中华人民共和国消费者权益保护法》《中华人民共和国认证认可条例》《强制性产品认证管理规定》等法律法规和规章要求，切实落实主体责任，抓紧抓实问题整改，严格执行“一车一池一充一码”标准规定和产品一致性管控要求，切实提升质量管理水平，坚决防止不合格产品流入市场；要主

items.title: 如何看待济南医保官方视频号工作人员误以为直播结束，骂咨询者脑子有病，医保局回应称已批评教育并要求道歉？
items.title_zh: 如何看待济南医保官方视频号工作人员误以为直播结束，骂咨询者脑子有病，医保局回应称已批评教育并要求道歉？
items.summary_zh: “听到她喊出我的网名，当众说我有病，我都难以置信。随后她又纳闷说，诶，直播还没结束吗？听到这，我可气又可笑。难道结束了，你就能骂我吗？我和你无冤无仇，我只是正常咨询问题。” 前一晚遭工作人员辱骂 次日直播回放不见了 11月26日，山东一名男子向华商报大风新闻反映，他在山东省济南市医保局的官方视频号直播间里，被出镜的工作人员点名辱骂：“xxx（男子网名）这个人脑子就跟有病一样，他x老是问等待期、等待期…” 男子提供了录屏视频，告诉华商报大风新闻记者，这事发生于11月23日晚8时许。当时他进入“济南医保”视频号直播间，镜头前有两位身着蓝色衬衣、佩戴领结的女性工作人员。直播间背景板上写着“济南医保云顾问”，不少网友在评论区留言咨询政策。他也留言询问居民医保、职工医保断缴后待遇等待期的问题。 “说实话，我真没多问，也没刷屏。对方第一次没解答清楚，我才再次追问。她们让我最好问一下属地的医保经办部门。

items.title_zh: 如何看待BBC援引据称俄统计局泄露数据估算俄军死亡超49万，克宫回应只有俄国防部有权公布损失数据？
items.summary_zh: BBC联合Mediazona报道，依托黑客组织获取的、据称来自俄国家统计局的死亡登记记录，估算自2022年俄乌冲突全面升级以来俄军死亡至少490334人；纳入失踪人员后，相关估算进一步推高至70万以上。 俄国家统计局承认遭遇网络攻击，但否认涉密数据泄露。克里姆林宫发言人佩斯科夫回应，唯一有权公布损失数据的是俄罗斯国防部。你怎么看？真实死亡人数大概是多少？ 新闻来源链接：BBC称俄军死亡人数或超49万，克宫回应：唯一有权公布损失数据的是俄国防部；乌官员称乌俄大规模换俘将分阶段实施

items.summary_zh: 11月26日，国家药品监督管理局批准贝普若韦生（商品名：贺舒可）上市，联合核苷（酸）类似物（NAs）用于慢性乙肝病毒感染的功能性治愈。据悉，贝普若韦生已于今年相继在日本、美国、加拿大获批，成为全球首个且唯一获得多国监管共同认定、以“功能性治愈”为治疗目标的乙肝新药。https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/pwvVlYV7aUCbXEA1UERI3Q

items.title: 马伯庸回应电视剧《两京十五日》争议，自己是用历史逻辑反推朱瞻基的来时路，如何看待这一创作方法？
items.title_zh: 马伯庸回应电视剧《两京十五日》争议，自己是用历史逻辑反推朱瞻基的来时路，如何看待这一创作方法？
items.summary_zh: 马伯庸：实际上这是大家对朱瞻基的误会，朱瞻基在历史上呢，是一个很有作为的皇帝，而且当时还会有叫仁宣之治，实际上能够有这样称呼的人并不多。 随着我对历史的了解呢，我们会发现啊，治理一个国家是一件非常复杂、非常难的事情，哪怕说只是能够做到中人之姿，你说跟秦皇汉武当然是没有办法比，但是他作为一个皇帝，我认为他是一个不能说是及格吧，已经是做到良接近优的一个皇帝。他的在任时间虽然并不长，但是他的种种作为也能看得出来，他确实是一个能够接地气，能够知道运作一个国家是怎么样的一个人。 所以我觉得呢，我的这个创作方法论是反推的，我们从宣德皇帝啊在任的这些种种的作为中，反推回去，他在年轻的时候发生了什么样的事情。可能这些事情呢，并不符合历史，但是呢，我觉得他符合的是一种历史逻辑。从他后面取得的这些成就来看，在当时的年轻时代，他有可能做出这些事情。以他的性格，以他的环境，以他身边种种人的这些反应来看，他可能没做

items.title: 模特七海发博表示 「我的脸已经成 AI 短剧里的赛博恶役」，AI 融脸为什么维权难？
items.title_zh: 模特七海发博表示 「我的脸已经成 AI 短剧里的赛博恶役」，AI 融脸为什么维权难？
items.summary_zh: 曾指控AI短剧《桃花簪》盗脸侵权的模特“七海”，发帖表示“我的脸已经成AI短剧里的赛博恶役了”，并晒出网友质疑《火狐》融脸其面部的图文。她表示，自己的脸已经被融进模型大数据里，基本AI短剧里的丑角或反派和自己有80%相似，但维权困难。 据悉，“七海”此前已起诉《桃花簪》方，至今仍未宣判。其代理律师赵一婕表示，“七海”的诉求很简单，把面部特征从数据库里移出，不想再看到任何的反派角色脸上有自己的痕迹。但是法律不支持预期权利的主张以及立案起诉，这并不是法律的错误，因为能最大程度地减少诉累，但是从实际操作的角度，当事人的脸已经被融了，这是所有人都看到并且认可的事实——会时不时蹦出来一个“邪恶七海”，当事人继续应激，然后陷入崩溃。告一个就要重新进行立案的程序，耗费一年左右的时间打官司。我们不可能挨个儿把所有AI生成图片视频的公司都告一遍，也不可能以侵犯隐私为由，要求审查数据库，挪出当事人的肖像。尽力

items.title: 安徽、上海等地借助 AI 抓贪官，具体是怎么抓的？有哪些优点和局限性？该如何应对不断变化的作案手法？
items.title_zh: 安徽、上海等地借助 AI 抓贪官，具体是怎么抓的？有哪些优点和局限性？该如何应对不断变化的作案手法？
items.summary_zh: AI正在帮忙抓贪官。 浙江省江山市，AI比对了一项城区亮化工程的26家投标企业得分，帮办案人员揪出了一名受贿干部——2025年11月，当地国有资产管理服务中心融资建设科原负责人冯疆，因受贿罪获刑二年六个月。这名县级市干部，曾在当地城投公司项目前期部工作多年。 冯疆案是2026年1月中央纪委国家监委公布的科技反腐案例之一，监管部门依靠AI、大数据技术和区块链等技术，揪出了小到事业单位办事员、大到正厅级干部的贪官。在正厅级落马官员中，中国证监会科技监管司原司长姚前收受了2000枚以太币（市值一度超过6000万元），根据官方通报，其“非法收受财物，数额特别巨大”，最终被移送至检察机关审查起诉。 在诸多反腐领域中，招投标成了AI重点盯上的靶子。 2026年以来，借助AI的追溯能力，包括安徽、上海、四川、江西在内的全国至少4个省级地区，正在倒查尘封多年的工程项目，并且陆续披露了招投标领域专项整治的进

items.title: 极客湾预估 PC 版《GTA6》2K60 帧整机预算约 1.4 万元，你会为玩这款游戏升级整机吗？
items.title_zh: 极客湾预估 PC 版《GTA6》2K60 帧整机预算约 1.4 万元，你会为玩这款游戏升级整机吗？
items.summary_zh: 编辑观点：知名硬件评测频道极客湾预测，《GTA6》想在2K分辨率下达到60帧，至少需要RTX 5070级别显卡搭配Ryzen 7 9700X处理器，整机预算约1.4万元。为了玩好一款《GTA6》，真的要花这么多钱吗？ 《GTA6》主机版发售后，PS5、PS5 Pro、Xbox Series X和Xbox Series S四台主机均锁定30帧，这一表现引发了不少玩家对游戏性能的讨论。 而PC玩家或许原本期待着未来能通过更强的硬件获得更好的体验，但极客湾近日发布的分析视频，又给这份期待泼了一盆冷水。 按照极客湾的预测，如果想在2K分辨率下跑到60帧，至少需要Ryzen 7 9700X处理器和RTX 5070级别显卡，整机预算约1.4万元。 需要强调的是，这只是第三方根据现有信息作出的预估，并非Rockstar公布的官方配置要求，最终表现仍要等PC版正式推出后才能确认。 但即便如此，这个数字也足

items.title: 南开大学几代学者攒 80 年藏 120 万只「臭大姐」标本，研究这类昆虫有哪些实际价值？
items.title_zh: 南开大学几代学者攒 80 年藏 120 万只「臭大姐」标本，研究这类昆虫有哪些实际价值？
items.summary_zh: 看到一只“臭大姐”，你下意识的举动差不多是屏住呼吸，然后拿扫把或者纸巾把它清理到室外。 在南开大学的一间屋子里，你面对一盒盒的漂亮虫子，第一反应很可能是：哎，这些怎么可能是“臭大姐”？ “臭大姐”是对蝽类昆虫的俗称，在南开大学昆虫学研究所一隅，蝽类标本就有约120万只，同层的实验室内，还有各种活体养殖。 这里怎么会收藏这么多的“臭大姐”？ 又为什么要研究“臭大姐”？ 这么多“臭大姐” 有的还挺漂亮 这间“神秘”的屋子，就在南开大学八里台校区生命科学学院第四教学楼里。 在昆虫学研究所所长卜文俊教授、昆虫学研究专家刘国卿教授的带领下，记者一行来到这间标本收藏室。 一进屋，樟脑丸味扑鼻、在狭窄的隔间之后，主空间放置的是一排排木柜，顶上摞着一个个方盒，屋子侧边和尽头两排则是铁皮柜，“我们估算过，大约有120万只，应该是国内最全的蝽类昆虫标本收藏。” 刘国卿教授与卜文俊教授（右） 卜文俊教授取出一个
